$comment: Numerology. mulank = day of birth reduced to 1-9; bhagyank (destiny) = all digits of DD MM YYYY reduced to 1-9; name number = sum of letter values reduced to 1-9. Reduction = repeated digit sums.
source: Chaldean letter values as used in Indian numerology (Cheiro); Pythagorean values A-I=1-9 repeating. Number-planet rulers as commonly used in Indian numerology.

review.note: Letter tables and planet rulers entered from commonly published sources; confirm with a numerology reviewer.
